name: AWS PPTX Generator
description: AWS-compliant PPTX deck generator. Produces 16:9 widescreen presentations following the official AWS brand system: Squid Ink dark / pure-white light themes, Smile Orange accent, eight service category colors, Amazon Ember + Arial typography, twelve canonical slide types (Cover, Agenda, Section Divider, Content, Architecture, Two-Column, Demo/Code, Customer Story, Comparison, Summary, Resources/CTA, Q&A).
author: Open Design

homeChip.label: AWS PPTX
homeChip.tagline: AWS-compliant 16:9 deck — Squid Ink + Smile Orange, Amazon Ember, twelve slide types

od.exampleBrief: Generate an AWS-styled deck following the official Architecture Icons brand system. Pick a theme (Light or Dark), pick a deck subject, the plugin produces a 12-page widescreen PPTX-equivalent HTML deck with cover, agenda, content, architecture, table, and Q&A slides.

skills.description: AWS PPTX deck builder — applies AWS brand system to deck framework
